summary: The exact candidate is valid scoped documentation and regression-test hardening for the BlockScan contribution already present on the prepared base. It corrects the shared-storage reuse example with an intervening fx.barrier(), adds independent multi-block/wave-boundary coverage, and explicitly avoids claiming completion of the broad building-block proposal. It changes no implementation or native code and therefore does not fully resolve upstream issue 1016.

tests.command: assert docs/extension/coop_scan.md exists on prepared base

The pre-existing implementation already passed 62 focused GPU tests, distinguishing the candidate from an implementation fix. Raw output: /job/review-evidence/base/test-block-scan.txt

Verified fx.barrier() occurs between consecutive inclusive and exclusive calls reusing storage and that the page disclaims completion of the whole library. Raw output: /job/review-evidence/candidate/import-and-doc-contract.txt
All 64 candidate focused BlockScan GPU tests passed, including the added multi-block wave-boundary cases. Raw output: /job/review-evidence/candidate/test-block-scan.txt

Independent int32 host-reference check for inclusive and exclusive scans sharing storage with a barrier across three blocks and wave64 boundaries. Raw output: /job/review-evidence/candidate/adversarial-block-scan.txt
All 326 cooperative extension tests passed on the candidate. Raw output: /job/review-evidence/candidate/test-coop.txt

remaining_counterexamples: The broad original proposal remains unresolved beyond the explicitly scoped block-wide prefix scan contribution.
Wave32 and non-gfx950 architectures were unavailable and remain unverified.
BlockScan remains limited to power-of-two thread counts, full-block participation, WARP_SCANS, and ReductionOp ADD/MUL/MIN/MAX.
Candidate PR 618 refers to historical mirror issue 604 rather than this review's assigned mirror issue 621.
remaining_limitations: No native C++ source changed, so rebuilding native code was not applicable.
Only gfx950 wave64 hardware was available for execution.
Raw review evidence is retained outside the checkout at /job/review-evidence/.
